definitions.gloss: registration; recording in an official register
definitions.explanation: The legal act of recording ownership, rights, or status in an official government register, especially for real estate, companies, and legal entities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登記|とうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{登記|とうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Registration is required to establish a company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{所有権|しょゆうけん}→所有権：17082_shoyuuken⟧⟦{移転|いてん}→移転：04000_iten⟧{登記|とうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{司法書士|しほうしょし}→司法書士：08747_shihoushoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: I asked a judicial scrivener to handle the property ownership transfer registration.

notes:
A legal and administrative term that learners in Japan will encounter when buying property, starting a business, or dealing with official documents. The {法務局|ほうむきょく} (Legal Affairs Bureau) handles registration in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧{登記|とうき} — real estate registration
- ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧{登記|とうき} — commercial registration
- {登記|とうき}{簿|ぼ} — register, registry book
- {登記|とうき}{所|しょ} — registry office
- ⟦{所有権|しょゆうけん}→所有権：17082_shoyuuken⟧⟦{移転|いてん}→移転：04000_iten⟧{登記|とうき} — ownership transfer registration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧ — registration (more general; used for memberships, accounts, etc.)
- ⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧ — notification, filing (e.g., marriage registration at city hall)
